card.name: Linking words before blood sugar terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, on, 's, including, regular) in diabetes-drug text right before blood glucose or hypoglycemia words. It fires where monitoring or warning about blood sugar comes next.

modes.label: Monitoring glucose
modes.description: A word just before blood glucose or sugar checks or monitoring.

modes.label: Counseling on hypoglycemia
modes.description: A preposition after inform or educate patients, before hypoglycemia risk or signs.
modes.example: Inform patients<< of>> the risk of hypoglycemia

card.writes: It suppresses blood-vessel words such as vascular and vessels, so the next word is steered away from vessel topics.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come just before the text mentions blood sugar checks or low blood sugar.
